label: CWO-1 as narrowed by B3-1 (2026-09-07)
history_rule: B3-1 requires every CWO-1 report to carry this label, so a reader comparing scans across the wave knows which predicate produced which digit

both_digits_over_the_shipping_corpus.the_one_row_that_differs: P02-006, whose key acrostic.triplet_nun_samekh_pe_partial carries the bare token samekh - a Hebrew LETTER name inside the acrostic namespace, which the narrowing permits and the issued list barred

where_the_label_now_lives: the close receipt, which states both digits
why_both_digits: reporting only the narrowed digit would let a reader think the issued order was satisfied as issued. It was not; it was narrowed by a recorded ruling, and the difference is exactly one row.
